caption: the nascar cartoon turned game - hot wheels logic on an oval, with the show's stunts intact.
about: Nascar racers (2000) adapts the animated nascar racers tv series into an arcade racer: futuristic stock cars with gadget attachments, story events between races and the show's team dynamics intact. It sits in a strange, charming gap - licensed cartoon racing built by hasbro interactive at the peak of the idea.
The windows build is abandonware carried openly by myabandonware; the archive route is the way in.
